h:
运行 Flux 模型的最基本工作流程。需要最新版本的 ComfyUI。

对于GGUF您需要安装此节点的型号：

  • https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

对于BNB NF4 一体机您需要安装此节点的型号：

  • https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI_bitsandbytes_NF4

对于BNB NF4/FP4 UNET模型，您需要安装此节点：

  • https://github.com/DenkingOfficial/ComfyUI_UNet_bitsandbytes_NF4

对于 UNET 模型，需要单独的文本编码器和 VAE。您可以在这里找到它们：

  • 文本编码器： https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/tree/main

  • VAE： https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell/tree/main/vae

o.en:
Most basic workflows for running Flux models. Needs the latest version of ComfyUI.

ForGGUFmodels you need to install this node:

  • https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

ForBNB NF4 All-in-onemodels you need to install this node:

  • https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI_bitsandbytes_NF4

ForBNB NF4/FP4 UNETmodels, you need to install this node:

  • https://github.com/DenkingOfficial/ComfyUI_UNet_bitsandbytes_NF4

For UNET models, separate Text encoders and VAE are necessary. You can find them here:

  • TEXT ENCODERS: https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/tree/main

  • VAE: https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell/tree/main/vae
